parameters.content:
## RM · 0 — every failure lands here

**Starts:** set as the *Error Workflow* on the other office workflows.

- **Classify failure** — tells an expected rejection ("no recorded human approval" — the gate working)
  from a real fault, and attaches what it means
- **Gateway: alert (deduped)** — the same workflow+node+error inside an hour becomes one message, not
  forty, and `/mute 4` silences them for a while
- **Telegram: alert** — the *fallback*, used only when the gateway is unreachable. That failure is
  precisely when an alert matters most, so it must not depend on the gateway.

parameters.pythonCode:
# n8n's Python task runner exposes `_items` (this node runs once for all items), NOT the JS
# helpers: there is no `$('Other Node')`, and the sandbox sets N8N_RUNNERS_STDLIB_ALLOW="" so even
# `import re` fails with "Security violations detected". Both nodes below are therefore written
# with plain built-ins and read only their own input. See n8n/README.md.

# Classify the failure so the alert says what KIND of problem it is. Rejections the system made on
# purpose (bad token, no approval, publishing disabled) are worth knowing about but are not outages —
# they get a different icon and a one-line "why".

def esc(s):
    """Telegram legacy Markdown: an unpaired _ * [ or ` in a value aborts the whole message
    ("can't parse entities"). Error text is full of them — tmdb_id, file paths, code."""
    out = str(s)
    for ch in ("_", "*", "[", "]", "`"):
        out = out.replace(ch, "\\" + ch)
    return out


j = _items[0]["json"]
wf = (j.get("workflow") or {}).get("name") or "unknown workflow"
ex = j.get("execution") or {}
node = ex.get("lastNodeExecuted") or "unknown node"
msg = ((ex.get("error") or {}).get("message") or "unknown error")[:300]
url = ex.get("url") or ""

# (any one of these phrases) -> why it is not an outage
EXPECTED = [
    (("bad token",),
     "a caller sent the wrong gateway token — the request was refused (correct)"),
    (("no recorded human approval",),
     "publish was attempted without an approval tap — the gate held (correct)"),
    (("publishing is disabled",),
     "STUDIO_ALLOW_PUBLISH is off — nothing was published (by design)"),
    (("econnrefused", "refused the connection"),
     "the gateway was unreachable — usually a restart; check ./scripts/office.sh status"),
    (("not active and cannot be executed",),
     "a sub-workflow is inactive — activate it in n8n"),
    (("nothing was queued",),
     "the Instagram enqueue refused the request — see the node that stopped"),
]

low = msg.lower()
why = next((w for phrases, w in EXPECTED if any(p in low for p in phrases)), None)

kind = "\u26a0\ufe0f Expected rejection" if why else "\U0001f6a8 Workflow failed"
text = (kind + " — *ReelMatch Marketing Office*\n\n"
        + "*Workflow:* " + esc(wf) + "\n*Node:* " + esc(node)
        + "\n*Error:* " + esc(msg))
if why:
    text += "\n*Why:* " + esc(why)
if url:
    text += "\n\n[Open execution](" + url + ")"

# text/ for the direct fallback; the rest for /alert, which dedupes and adds the remedy
return [{"json": {"text": text, "workflow": wf, "node": node, "message": msg, "url": url}}]
